questions.question: What did the LORD say He would send on Egypt if Pharaoh refused to let His people go?
When Egypt was covered in frogs, what did Pharaoh ask Moses and Aaron to do?

answers.text: Pray to the LORD to take the frogs away
Strike the river with the staff again
Order the frogs out of the palace

questions.question: When Aaron brought frogs up onto Egypt, Pharaoh's magicians tried to copy it but could not. True or false?
When gnats covered the people and animals of Egypt, what did Pharaoh's magicians say to him?

answers.text: This is the finger of God
This is the staff of Aaron
This is the hand of Moses
